verdict.rationale: Unity ships an official in-editor AI Assistant (com.unity.ai.assistant). Its docs say it creates assets, automates workflows, analyzes performance and performs project actions from natural-language prompts. Asset generation (images, 3D models, sound effects) and Assistant messaging are metered via Unity Credits, so the core story of an official assistant doing engine tasks is delivered. missing for 10: explicit evidence of script generation and API question-answering, a stable (non-beta/pre-release) release, independent hands-on corroboration.
